description: Current components, implemented operations layer and explicitly proposed expansions. Existence is not operational admission or proof of benefit.

nodes.title: Repository evidence
nodes.inputs: Briefs, logs, decisions, local receipts
nodes.outputs: Original path, bytes, declared proof class
nodes.gate: Original records retained; no success inferred from words
nodes.next_action: Use source path and SHA-256 rather than repeated numeric prefixes

nodes.title: Current campaign authority
nodes.inputs: Current manifest, graph, queue, repository identity
nodes.outputs: Bounded role context or explicit refusal
nodes.gate: Hash, semantic and repository identity checks pass
nodes.next_action: Resolve admission through existing owner transition; a history query grants none

nodes.title: Operations corpus index
nodes.inputs: Scoped local UTF-8 sources
nodes.outputs: Rebuildable SQLite, coverage, content hashes, skipped/missing rows
nodes.gate: All discovered text has an explicit disposition; deletion and drift are tested
nodes.next_action: Refresh before retrieval; disclose oversized and excluded inputs

nodes.title: Source-span retrieval
nodes.inputs: Literal query and optional source kind
nodes.outputs: Ranked source lines, hash, current/stale indication
nodes.gate: Quoted spans resolve to exact indexed source lines; no command execution
nodes.next_action: Inspect citations before applying a historical technique

nodes.title: Collective operational lessons
nodes.inputs: Observed failures, successful techniques, exact source citations
nodes.outputs: Proposed lesson, recommended action, falsifiable validation
nodes.gate: Every source hash and span verifies; proposed status stays explicit
nodes.next_action: Review lesson applicability and test its claimed benefit before promotion

nodes.title: Bounded task context
nodes.inputs: Task query, verified citations, current authority
nodes.outputs: Size-bounded context packet with relevant lessons and omitted counts
nodes.gate: Packet stays inside declared byte budget; stale evidence is marked
nodes.next_action: Prepare context before a new task and keep the source retrieval reproducible

nodes.title: Human evidence browser
nodes.inputs: Shared operations snapshot
nodes.outputs: Terminal watch, filterable source browser, lesson and structure details
nodes.gate: Snapshot timestamp and refresh command visible; text is escaped
nodes.next_action: Inspect source metadata and dependency gates, then record feedback

nodes.title: Human feedback journal
nodes.inputs: Note, hypothesis, decision, feedback or milestone annotation
nodes.outputs: Append-only ordered local events
nodes.gate: Annotations cannot change campaign or lesson authority
nodes.next_action: Record an observation with the source or lesson ID as subject

nodes.title: Studio simulation inspection
nodes.inputs: Catalog, SAIL observatory, factory project, process snapshot
nodes.outputs: Eight-stage simulation view and current activity
nodes.gate: Existing receipt and current-state validators remain authoritative
nodes.next_action: Later consume the same operations read model; avoid a second history database

nodes.title: Task and artifact contracts
nodes.inputs: Scope, inputs, authority, cost/time budgets
nodes.outputs: Hash-bound task, artifact and review envelopes
nodes.gate: Semantic authorization is validated in addition to file hashes
nodes.next_action: Generate suggestions for contracts, leaving admission with existing validators

nodes.title: Leased software test runner
nodes.inputs: Authorized test command and task contract
nodes.outputs: Owned child process, timeout, logs and receipt
nodes.gate: Lease actual child before exec; concurrent duplicate run refused
nodes.next_action: Reuse for future bounded software jobs after separate scope admission

nodes.title: Exact-identity verification reuse
nodes.inputs: HEAD/tree, command, relevant paths, dependencies, runtime
nodes.outputs: Reusable passing receipt or required rerun
nodes.gate: Any declared relevant input drift invalidates reuse
nodes.next_action: Measure cache-hit rate and input completeness before broadening reuse

nodes.title: Independent review and closeout
nodes.inputs: Scoped diff, test receipt, source identity, claim boundary
nodes.outputs: CONTINUE/NUDGE/REDIRECT/STOP/ESCALATE with evidence
nodes.gate: STOP, stale HEAD or self-asserted evaluator identity cannot authorize merge
nodes.next_action: Review terminal negative as a valid result when the scientific gate warrants it

nodes.title: Simulation scene construction
nodes.inputs: Reviewed scene geometry, camera, material and dynamics inputs
nodes.outputs: Versioned MuJoCo scene and rendered diagnostic
nodes.gate: Frozen scene identity and scoped evidence class retained
nodes.next_action: Optimize measured bottlenecks with byte/semantic equivalence controls

nodes.title: Exact-action replay
nodes.inputs: Hash-bound measured initial state and unchanged action tensor
nodes.outputs: Eligibility audit and exact replay trace
nodes.gate: No IK, clipping, offset, suffix or hidden assistance in exact-action proof
nodes.next_action: Check prerequisite eligibility before spending on replay or fitting

nodes.title: Causal simulation analysis
nodes.inputs: Paired trace, event windows, contact/timing residuals, independent measurement
nodes.outputs: Identified residual, falsified hypothesis or explicit unknown
nodes.gate: Event and contact parity cannot be replaced by endpoint appearance
nodes.next_action: Use cheapest discriminating test; stop exhausted explanations pending new evidence

nodes.title: Independent capability evaluation
nodes.inputs: Frozen scenarios/seeds, candidate artifacts, controls
nodes.outputs: Separated fixture/simulation/replay/learned/physical verdicts
nodes.gate: Training never grades or promotes itself; held-out isolation is maintained
nodes.next_action: Report per-proof-class gates and whole-episode reliability

nodes.title: Physical acquisition and robot gateway
nodes.inputs: Action-time camera/serial/motion authority and hardware readiness
nodes.outputs: Physical receipt and measured observations
nodes.gate: Only reviewed gateway can operate hardware; software history grants no access
nodes.next_action: Remain at current external-input boundary until independently authorized

nodes.title: Reviewed reusable technique registry
nodes.inputs: Lesson plus reproducible command/input/output contract
nodes.outputs: Versioned coding, rendering and analysis recipe
nodes.gate: Frozen positive/negative controls; measured quality and time advantage
nodes.next_action: Start with OR79 equivalence optimization, context preparation and exact receipt reuse

nodes.title: Learning effectiveness benchmark
nodes.inputs: Frozen retrieval tasks and baseline/candidate agent contexts
nodes.outputs: Time-to-evidence, citation accuracy, repeated-work and token-cost comparison
nodes.gate: Paired trials and independent scoring; no configured-label score substituted
nodes.next_action: Freeze 20 representative historical questions before changing retrieval or prompts

nodes.title: Resource-aware software scheduling
nodes.inputs: Admitted software task, dependency graph, resource and cost budget
nodes.outputs: Queue/wait/run/cancel state using existing leases
nodes.gate: Single owner, bounded work, no stale PID cleanup, external cost closeout
nodes.next_action: Measure queue wait before adding per-identity concurrency

nodes.title: Live event adapters
nodes.inputs: Existing runner events and Studio heartbeat snapshots
nodes.outputs: Cursor-based phase history, job status, human-visible progress
nodes.gate: Snapshot vs complete history labeled; dropped sequence and reconnect tested
nodes.next_action: Add event envelopes at existing phase boundaries instead of scraping terminal text

nodes.title: Verified cross-record relationships
nodes.inputs: Source->contract->attempt->receipt->review references and hashes
nodes.outputs: Typed edges with existence/hash/semantic verification state
nodes.gate: Missing, contradictory, stale and historical relations remain visible
nodes.next_action: Add schema-specific adapters for dev-loop, SAIL and task-orchestrator receipts

nodes.title: Portable reproducible operations bundle
nodes.inputs: Reviewed lessons, source manifests, configuration and scoped outputs
nodes.outputs: Export/import with redaction and verification report
nodes.gate: Missing ignored artifacts and private data explicit; no embedded credentials
nodes.next_action: Define portable manifest and artifact hydration policy before sharing

nodes.title: Robot-specific workspace exchange
nodes.owner: Sim2Claw operations and MicroDuck Duck Lab adapter owners
nodes.inputs: Native mandates, ordered action/unit/observation/time declarations and exact source hashes
nodes.outputs: Non-executing workspace envelope, conformance and explicit ABI differences
nodes.gate: Shared schema/fixture digests and bilateral source-bound checks; no policy portability inference
nodes.next_action: Re-export when bound sources change; require both native validators before changing the exchange contract

nodes.title: MicroDuck native training dojo
nodes.owner: MicroDuck workspace, training and diagnostics tasks
nodes.inputs: Frozen fourteen-action/fifty-hertz interface, native ordered training queue and evaluator bindings
nodes.outputs: Duck Lab metadata; native trace comparisons and independently owned behavior evidence
nodes.gate: Native training/evaluator rules remain authoritative; records and tensors are not exported by v1
nodes.next_action: Consume metadata through the exchange without importing the peer runtime

nodes.title: Bound robot-specific diagnostic traces
nodes.inputs: Declared case/reset/model identity, per-axis units, coordinate frames, clock domain, ordered actions and exact trace bytes
nodes.outputs: Source-linked first differences and an explicit recorded-action comparison class
nodes.gate: Positive and negative cross-reader fixtures; no resampling, action conversion or physics-causality inference
nodes.next_action: Bind MicroDuck trace-comparison v1 and a separately authored Sim2Claw producer before admitting shared trace records

milestones.title: Evidence index and visible operations
milestones.gate: Complete explicit corpus coverage, source retrieval, cited lessons, bounded context, feedback and interactive report pass independent review

milestones.title: Verify cross-record meaning
milestones.gate: Schema adapters validate dev-loop, SAIL and task receipts; tampered hashes, STOP and mixed outcomes remain distinct

milestones.title: Demonstrate learning benefit
milestones.gate: Frozen 20-question evidence set, paired baseline/candidate timing and citation scoring, no regression in proof boundaries

milestones.title: Connect visible bounded execution
milestones.gate: Existing runner and leases reused; live phase history, human cancellation and crash recovery demonstrated on software fixtures

milestones.title: Promote reusable simulation recipes
milestones.gate: Each recipe has independent quality and cost controls; no physical/heldout/promotion authority follows automatically
